reason: The premise is wrong, and the proposed fix has an expected value of zero or below. (1) The insertion gate is PER CLIP. In tools/build_probe_kernel.py l.1413-1421, safetail_divins_allowed(dataset) compares the kernel elapsed time since KERNEL_START_TS with 28,800 s for each dataset. So a V* whose kernel ran past 8.0 h loses the insertion only on the clips processed after that point. It is never 'a file with no insertion'. (2) The ledger's L is poll time minus submit time: queue (~11-12 min), kernel, scoring and a poll gap of up to 10 min. Runtime <= L, so L_hi in (8.0, 9.0] does not show that the gate fired. A kernel at L_hi <= 9.0 h ran <= ~8.6-8.8 h, so at most ~7-9% of the ~97 hidden clips could have lost the insertion. (3) The plan already priced this band before any score: CONTEXT l.2043, V4 ROW 5, '8.0 < B <= 9.0 h -> at most the insertion on the last-sorted clips is lost (<~1e-4)'. (4) Trade-off: a V* displaying 0.955 against #37's 0.954 is expected to carry ~0.3-0.5 of ~+0.001 onto private, about +0.0003..0.0005. The fix would swap it back to #37 to save at most ~1e-4 of partial insertion (lab +0.006 x ~1/6 transfer x <= 9% of clips). {V*, #38} still has one file WITH the insertion on >= ~91% of clips and one without, so the hedge is essentially intact. (5) Reaching the band is unlikely. The ladder knobs are graph passes or thresholds (<< 1 min per clip). K2's L was in (7.36, 7.54] h, and #35's L_hi was 7.73 h. Joint P(eligible V* at >= 0.955 AND L_hi in (8, 9]) is ~<1-2%, so the expected impact either way is ~1e-6. Feasibility itself is fine: a rule line, no code, no slot, loggable before ~04:30Z, no R1-R10 conflict. The finding is still refuted on value, because it describes a hole that does not exist in the claimed form, and its fix would over-exclude a V* that the plan expects to beat #37.
fix: Do not adopt the ineligibility rule. If the main session wants the ledger column read, log one INFO line before ~04:30Z: 'L9: a V* with 8.0 < L_hi <= 9.0 h stays eligible. The in-kernel gate is per clip, so at most the last ~<=9% of clips may lack the insertion, priced <~1e-4 (V4 row 5). The pair stays {V*, #38}, and the morning push states the ledger insertion-gate text for V*.' For exp72 no change is needed now: it has no user yes and no finals row, and PC13-05 already requires L_hi <= 8.0 h there. The R13L-3 class-A 0.954 extension can keep its L_hi <= 8.0 h clause, which is harmless and more conservative for a weaker (0.954) candidate.
realistic_gain: ~0 (about 1e-6 expected). Conditional on the band occurring (~<1-2%), the proposed rule costs ~+0.0002..0.0004 of expected private score (V* swapped back to #37) to protect <= ~1e-4 of partial insertion. It is negative in expectation, but negligible in absolute terms.
